name: Vine Whip
desc: Lash out with a vine that damages, roots and pulls an enemy closer.

name: Spore Cloud
desc: A cloud of spores that poisons and slows everyone in it.

name: Thorn Skin
desc: Grow thorns: gain armor and a barrier, and reflect part of the damage you take.

name: Regrowth
desc: Heal yourself and nearby allies, then keep healing for a few seconds.

name: Wild Sprint
desc: Sprint as a rush of leaves, slowing enemies you run through.

name: Healing Bloom
desc: A flower that heals allies standing near it.

name: Wild Bloom
desc: Giant roots burst from the ground, damaging and rooting every enemy in the area.

name: Forest's Wrath
desc: The forest wakes: a huge area roots and tears enemies while healing your team.

name: Tidal Wave
desc: Send a wave that knocks enemies back and slows them.

name: Water Jet
desc: A high-pressure jet that hits instantly and pushes the target.

name: Bubble Shield
desc: Wrap yourself in a bubble that absorbs damage.

name: Riptide
desc: Sprint on a riptide, leaving slowing water behind you.

name: Coral Spikes
desc: A patch of sharp coral that slows and cuts anyone in it.

name: Healing Tide
desc: A calm wave that heals nearby allies and washes away debuffs.

name: Maelstrom
desc: A whirlpool pulls every nearby enemy toward you and hurts them.

name: Tsunami
desc: A towering wave smashes through everything in front of you.

name: Fireball
desc: A fireball that explodes on impact and sets enemies on fire.

name: Flame Breath
desc: A short burst of flame in front of you.

name: Fire Sprint
desc: Sprint leaving a trail of fire.

name: Ember Shield
desc: Wrap yourself in embers: a barrier that burns attackers.

name: Magma Pool
desc: A pool of molten rock that burns anyone standing in it.

name: Heat Wave
desc: A wave of heat that scorches and blinds nearby enemies.

name: Inferno Ring
desc: A ring of fire erupts around you and sets everything it touches alight.

name: Supernova
desc: A marked area detonates in a huge fiery blast.

name: Ice Shard
desc: Three icy shards that chill whatever they hit.

name: Frost Nova
desc: A burst of cold that damages, chills and holds enemies close to you.

name: Ice Wall
desc: Raise a wall of ice that blocks shots and movement.

name: Frost Blink
desc: Blink forward and gain a short burst of speed.

name: Blizzard
desc: A storm of snow that chills and blinds anyone inside.

name: Glacial Armor
desc: A shell of ice that absorbs damage and chills enemies who get close.

name: Avalanche Strike
desc: Snow and ice crash down on a large area.

name: Absolute Zero
desc: Everything around you freezes solid.

name: Lightning Bolt
desc: An instant bolt of lightning.

name: Thunder Clap
desc: A thunderclap that stuns and shoves everyone near you.

name: Storm Sprint
desc: Sprint as lightning, shocking everything you run through.

name: Chain Lightning
desc: Lightning that jumps to nearby enemies.

name: Static Field
desc: A crackling field that shocks anyone inside.

name: Sky Hammer
desc: Leap into the air and slam down with the force of thunder.

name: Thunderstorm
desc: Lightning rains over a wide area.

name: Wrath of the Heavens
desc: Six lightning strikes hammer the nearest enemies.

name: Soul Bolt
desc: A bolt of spirit energy that heals you for part of the damage.

name: Bone Spear
desc: A spear of bone that pierces everything in a line.

name: Raise Skeleton
desc: Raise two skeletons that shoot nearby enemies.

name: Death Coil
desc: A coil of dark magic that drains life.

name: Wither
desc: A curse that withers the target.

name: Grave Step
desc: Slip through the grave and reappear ahead, briefly unseen.

name: Grave Eruption
desc: Bone hands tear out of the ground and hurl enemies.

name: Army of the Dead
desc: Five armoured skeletons rise and fight for you.

name: Arcane Missiles
desc: Five homing missiles of pure arcane energy.

name: Mana Shield
desc: A shield of mana that absorbs damage and speeds mana recovery.

name: Arcane Blink
desc: Blink forward.

name: Silence Ray
desc: A ray that stops the target from casting.

name: Arcane Orb
desc: A slow orb that bursts in a wide blast.

name: Rune Trap
desc: Place a rune that springs on the first enemy who steps on it.

name: Arcane Explosion
desc: A burst of raw magic that hurts and silences enemies around you.

name: Arcane Cataclysm
desc: A cataclysmic blast that silences everyone caught in it.

name: Poison Flask
desc: A flask that shatters in a cloud of poison.

name: Toxic Gas
desc: A lingering cloud of toxic gas.

name: Antidote
desc: Heal and cleanse yourself and nearby allies.

name: Acid Spit
desc: Acid that eats armour and burns.

name: Sticky Brew
desc: A puddle of goo that slows and sometimes sticks enemies.

name: Swift Elixir
desc: Drink a potion for speed and extra damage.

name: Cauldron Burst
desc: A giant cauldron bursts and drenches the area in poison.

name: Plague Cloud
desc: A vast cloud of plague that poisons and weakens everyone inside.

name: Cannon Shot
desc: Fire a small cannon: a heavy shell with a wide blast.

name: Grapple Sprint
desc: Haul yourself along with a grappling hook for a long, fast sprint.

name: Crossbow Volley
desc: Fire a volley of six bolts in an arc.

name: Smoke Bomb
desc: A cloud of smoke that blinds enemies inside.

name: Rum Ration
desc: A swig of rum: heal, regenerate and run.

name: Sabre Rush
desc: Sprint with a cutlass out, slashing everyone you run through.

name: Broadside
desc: Call a broadside: cannonballs smash down on the target area.

name: Ghost Ship
desc: A phantom ship rakes the area with cannon fire for several seconds.

name: Time Slow
desc: A bubble where time crawls: enemies inside are heavily slowed.

name: Rewind
desc: Rewind yourself to where you stood a few seconds ago and heal.

name: Quicken
desc: Speed up your own time: move, shoot and cast faster.

name: Stasis Bolt
desc: A bolt that freezes the target in time for a moment.

name: Temporal Echo
desc: Sprint through time, leaving an echo behind that slows enemies.

name: Age
desc: Age the target: they take extra damage and move slowly.

name: Chrono Burst
desc: A burst of time energy that damages and slows everything near you.

name: Stop Time
desc: Time stops for your enemies. You do not.

name: Moonbeam
desc: A beam of moonlight that reveals and marks the target.

name: Starfall
desc: A star falls from the sky onto the marked spot.

name: Lunar Shield
desc: A shield of moonlight that absorbs damage and blocks debuffs.

name: Gravity Well
desc: A well of gravity that drags enemies into its centre.

name: Phase Blink
desc: Phase forward through space.

name: Blessing
desc: A blessing that heals, regenerates and cleanses allies.

name: Eclipse Pulse
desc: A pulse of darkness that blinds and slows nearby enemies.

name: Moonfall
desc: A piece of the moon falls onto the battlefield.

name: Pawn Push
desc: Push a pawn that shoves enemies back.

name: Knight Leap
desc: Jump in an L-shaped arc and crush enemies where you land.

name: Bishop's Beam
desc: A diagonal beam that pierces everything in a line.

name: Rook Charge
desc: Charge in a straight line like a rook.

name: Queen's Gambit
desc: A sweeping attack in a wide arc that leaves enemies exposed.

name: Castling
desc: Swap position across the board and gain a small barrier.

name: Fork
desc: Attack two places at once: everything in the area is hit and held.

name: Queen Sacrifice
desc: Spawn a huge queen and sacrifice it: she sweeps across the board and shatters. A kill with an ultimate ends in checkmate.

name: Shadow Step
desc: Step through the dust to the back of the nearest enemy and gain speed.

name: Sand Veil
desc: Vanish in a veil of sand until you strike.

name: Venom Blade
desc: Coat your blades: every hit poisons and hurts more.

name: Smoke Bomb
desc: A cloud of smoke that blinds and slows nearby enemies.

name: Dagger Fan
desc: Throw a fan of daggers that make enemies bleed.

name: Mirage
desc: Two mirages of you run in different directions while you slip away.

name: Sand Sprint
desc: Sprint through enemies and cut them as you pass.

name: Quick Slash
desc: A fast sweeping cut in front of you.

name: Sirocco Gust
desc: A hot gust that shoves enemies away and fills their eyes with sand.

name: Mark for Death
desc: Mark a target: everyone sees it and it takes extra damage.

name: Dust Devil Flurry
desc: You spin into a dust devil of blades that cuts everything around you.

name: Vanishing Slaughter
desc: You vanish, then every enemy nearby is cut to ribbons at once.

name: Thorn Volley
desc: A spray of thorns that make enemies bleed.

name: Leaf Storm
desc: A whirl of razor leaves around you.

name: Wild Growth
desc: Plants lift you: faster and healing.

name: Stinging Swarm
desc: Wasps chase the target and poison it.

name: Trident Throw
desc: Hurl your trident through everything in a line.

name: Ink Cloud
desc: A cloud of dark ink that blinds and slows.

name: Undertow
desc: A current that drags one enemy to you.

name: Pearl Barrier
desc: A pearl shell absorbs damage and heals you.

name: Flame Wall
desc: A wall of fire that burns whoever crosses it.

name: Ember Barrage
desc: A burst of embers in a wide spread.

name: Phoenix Rise
desc: Rise from the ashes: heal, regenerate and gain a barrier.

name: Lava Whip
desc: A whip of lava that burns and pulls.

name: Ice Lance
desc: A fast lance of ice that pierces.

name: Frozen Ground
desc: The ground around you freezes and slows enemies.

name: Icicle Rain
desc: Icicles fall from the sky over an area.

name: Permafrost
desc: Skin like ice: much tougher and hard to slow.

name: Storm Call
desc: Call down lightning on an area.

name: Overcharge
desc: Crackle with power: faster hands and feet.

name: Thunder Javelin
desc: A javelin of lightning that pierces.

name: Lightning Step
desc: Vanish in a flash and leave a shocking spot behind.

name: Bone Armor
desc: A shell of bones absorbs damage.

name: Curse of Decay
desc: An area of rot that weakens everyone in it.

name: Soul Drain
desc: Drain life from an enemy and heal.

name: Bone Prison
desc: Bones close around enemies and hold them.

name: Mana Surge
desc: Surge of mana: refill some and cast faster for a short time.

name: Prism Beam
desc: A beam of light that pierces everything.

name: Gravity Rune
desc: A hidden rune that slows and holds whoever steps on it.

name: Arcane Barrage
desc: A flurry of bolts.

name: Plague Vial
desc: A vial that shatters into a poison splash.

name: Bubbling Cauldron
desc: A cauldron that bubbles poison onto the ground.

name: Panacea
desc: A cure-all that heals allies and cleanses debuffs.

name: Caustic Mist
desc: A spray of caustic mist.

name: Powder Keg
desc: A hidden keg that explodes when an enemy steps close.

name: Boarding Axe
desc: Throw an axe that bites deep and slows.

name: Parrot Scout
desc: Your parrot circles overhead and shows nearby enemies.

name: Anchor Slam
desc: Leap and slam an anchor into the ground.

name: Hourglass
desc: A bubble where time crawls.

name: Time Skip
desc: Skip forward a few moments and gain a small barrier.

name: Overclock
desc: Everything about you runs faster.

name: Paradox Bolt
desc: A bolt that is hit before it is thrown.

name: Crescent Slash
desc: A wide slash of moonlight that silences magic users.

name: Star Shower
desc: Stars fall over a wide area.

name: Moon Mend
desc: Moonlight heals nearby allies.

name: Night Veil
desc: A veil of night protects and quickens you.

name: En Passant
desc: Capture in passing: sprint through an enemy and leave it exposed.

name: Zugzwang
desc: Every move makes it worse: enemies in the area are slowed and weakened.

name: Promotion
desc: A pawn becomes a queen: stronger skills and more speed.

name: Stalemate
desc: Enemies in the area cannot move.
